system.description: Probe Droids try to coax a little more range out of their sensor equipment to get that extra amount of information about the area they are scanning. A Sensor Booster is a Droid Accessory that extends the range of its sensors to a maximum of 2 kilometers, if the Droid has a Sensor Pack installed.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
